paragraphs.text: Welcome to the enchanting realm of Marie Hartig's Painted Worlds.
Marie creates site-specific painted environments for private residences and architectural spaces, immersing you in exotic scenes and bringing far-flung realities onto your walls.

Developed in close dialogue with each client and in response to the character of the space, her work brings atmosphere, narrative and artistry into interiors - transforming the familiar into something extraordinary.
*“Every wall painting is conceived to feel as though it was always meant to be there - elevating the atmosphere, enriching the energy and becoming part of the life of the space.”*

Marie has created vast murals in Austrian and German castles, five-star hotels and fashionable restaurants, Caribbean beach homes, a children’s hospital in Buenos Aires and a pre-school in Mathare, Nairobi. She has painted holiday homes in Mallorca, stylish London and Milanese apartments - and even the tiniest of WCs.

Drawing on her background in Fine Arts, a passion for natural history and cultural influences from around the globe, Marie’s work ranges from sweeping landscapes and playful chinoiserie to vibrant menageries of flora and fauna and more graphic compositions.
Every Painted World is one of a kind, created especially for its setting and never replicated.
*“Those who commission a wall painting value the care, craftsmanship and imagination behind something truly unique - created with skill, dedication and, above all, love.”*

Born in Tokyo to Austrian diplomat parents, Marie grew up between Japan, Pakistan and Kenya the UK before settling into Austria. This international childhood - shaped by changing landscapes, cultures and visual traditions - continues to weave its way into her work today.

After studying Fine Arts and Communication in London, followed by a Master’s in Global Politics at Birkbeck, Marie spent more than a decade in film and advertising. In 2006, she co-founded the international film directors’ agency HOBEN.TV, remaining a partner until 2021. Painting, however, was always in the background.
*"I love to work closely with my clients, exploring their visions for the space and brining it to life"*

In 2012, a gift for her young goddaughter changed everything. Marie transformed the child’s white bedroom into a jungle - complete with a lion dozing on a branch and a curious monkey peering into the crib. 

It was a revelation. Where canvas had sometimes felt confined, an entire room offered limitless possibility. The architecture became part of the artwork. She had found her medium.
Today, Marie lives in Vienna and works internationally, collaborating with private clients, interior designers and architects to create one-of-a-kind Painted Worlds.
*“Hand-painted walls: It is wall jewellery. It’s the new bling !”*
